Calcarea Picrica.



Picrate of Calcium. 2 (C 6 H 2
        (NO 2 ) 3 ) OCa.



Clinical. ─   Ear, perifollicular inflammation of.
        Boils in meatus.



Characteristics. ─   "Indicated by clinical
        experience for perifollicular inflammation. The extreme prostration of Picric acid is
        relieved by this salt also" (Houghton). Minute and excessively painful boils in meatus.
        Picric acid and all its salts are curative in states of intense prostration and fatigue.



Relations. ─     Compare:
        Picric acid, Ferr. pic.
